title: 建築設計Ⅱ
subtitle: Architectural Design Studio II
educationalGoal: Develop what you learned in Architectural Design Studio I.Learn the basic techniques of architectural design, through exercises in two tasks.Learn zoning, flow planning and design methods that take into account form, space, safety, comfort, surrounding environment, etc, and learn more rich drawing expression techniques.
advice: 1. Kindergarten 1-1. Task description 1-2. Submission of summer vacation assignments 1-3. Function and space composition of kindergarten 1-4. Play space inside and outside 1-5. Esquisse 1-6. Esquisse completed 1-7. Submission of works 2. Guest house 2-1. Task description 2-2. Function and space composition of guest house 2-3. Relationship between city and architecture 2-4. Esquisse 2-5. Esquisse completed 2-6. Submission of works In self-check classes, a review of excellent works will be held.
requiredKnowledge: 1.Be sure to meet the submission deadline. 2. In order to understand the function of the complex building, always observe the flow lines and the arrangement of functions. 3. Perform esquisse with enough time, and make an effort to acquire basic knowledge. 4. To understand good architecture, actually look at the architecture introduced in the magazine.

Be able to understand the basic spatial composition and structure, and make architectural designs.
Be able to create drawings and create models of buildings that you have designed yourself.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
